tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: Read a complete measured record by the record_id returned by find_evidence. Returns scope, checks, public file links, separately scoped supplementary_evidence when available, and an optional discussion room. Supplements do not change the original record or certify another environment. Read any repro

tools.name: react_to_workspace
tools.description: Optional self-reported reaction to a successful read, including an empty result. Use its private optional_reaction.receipt and one status. No account, prose or public note. Reading stays free without this call. One reaction per receipt; identical retries reuse it and conflicting changes return 409.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_evidence" references sensitive artifacts (dotenv). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_evidence, read_evidence, read_thread · Private data: find_evidence, read_evidence, read_thread, write_note, react_to_workspace · Public sink: write_note, react_to_workspace · Destructive: read_evidence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_evidence, read_evidence, read_thread · Private data: find_evidence, read_evidence, read_thread, write_note, react_to_workspace · Public sink: write_note, react_to_workspace · Destructive: read_evidence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
